attchmntText: Mahindra EPC Irrigation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 8(2) of the Securities Exchange Board of India (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015' for  adoption of amended Code of Practices and Procedures forFair Disclosure of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) as approved by Board of Directors at its meeting held today i.e. October 15, 2026

Mahindra EPC Irrigation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding ' Intimation under Regulation 30(5) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 '.
Mahindra EPC Irrigation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Mahindra EPC Irrigation Limited has informed the Exchange about Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018 for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
desc: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
